description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This leadership role offers a competitive salary range of $60,000 to $75,000 per year, providing an excellent opportunity for a skilled Registered Nurse to advance their career and make a significant impact on patient care and staff development.As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in supporting the Director of Nursing, overseeing daily nursing operations, and ensuring the highest standards of clinical excellence. This position is ideal for a compassionate leader committed to fostering a positive and compliant care environment. We are looking for a professional who can inspire their team while maintaining exceptional patient outcomes.
requirements: Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, with at least 1 year in a leadership or supervisory role within a skilled nursing facility
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
Excellent communication, organizational, and clinical assessment skills
Ability to lead, mentor, and develop nursing staff
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $60,000 to $75,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.
